purpose: Every new 08:00 report body and structured source must explicitly carry the source facts required by the fixed 16-zone infographic. The infographic renderer may classify and arrange source facts but must not invent missing content.

output_policy.missing_fact_policy: Write an explicit source-gap statement only when the underlying fact is unavailable; do not fabricate or infer it.
output_policy.numeric_policy: Each displayed numeric value must bind to numeric_registry with value, unit, as_of, and exact body excerpt.

generation_qa.structured_fact_policy: Every required item below is emitted as an individually addressable fact with a stable fact_id and exact source_excerpt substring of body_text.
generation_qa.numeric_fact_policy: Every numeric value used by an index/data/outlook row has a numeric_registry entry bound to its owning fact_id, exact excerpt, unit, and as_of. No numeric value may be inferred from another field.
generation_qa.unavailable_value_policy: A genuinely unavailable value must be an explicit source-bound 取得不能（理由） fact. It must not be guessed, copied from a prior slot, or silently omitted.

zones.title: 総合判断
required_facts: one or more explicit source-bound reasons

zones.title: 本日の注目ポイント
required_facts: exactly five ordered, individually identifiable points

zones.title: 材料と市場の関係
required_facts: explicitly stated direction or causal link

zones.title: 昨夜のNY市場の時系列
required_facts: 東京時間／次時間帯への引継ぎ

zones.title: NY主要指数
required_facts: Russell 2000; close, change and percent change when stated

zones.title: 主要市場データ
required_facts: rates, sentiment and valuation; each numeric value with unit/as_of/source fact

zones.title: NY市場のポイント
required_facts: source-bound bullet observations and stated drivers

zones.title: クロスアセット資金フロー
required_facts: causal link when source states one
structured fields origin_asset, destination_asset, direction, causal_link

zones.title: 需給・ポジション
required_facts: separately identifiable supply, positioning, investor-flow or event facts

zones.title: 主要6市場の短期見通し
required_facts: each of 金, WTI原油, 日経225先物（大阪取引所）, USD/JPY, EUR/USD, BTCUSD with current value/as_of, judgement, bullish condition, bearish condition

zones.title: 最新ニュース・材料
required_facts: at least one item; each item has headline, source-stated time, affected market, price reaction

zones.title: 次時間帯への引継ぎ
required_facts: ordered source-bound monitoring points for the next slot

zones.title: 最終まとめ
required_facts: concise conclusion consistent with the source facts

rendering_rule: Preserve zone order and fixed geometry. Missing source facts remain visible SOURCE GAP entries in DRAFT and fail content completeness; layout checks continue independently.
